notes: «عَمِّي» before a name is the uncle, so the link is the name alone («محمدبن أبي القاسم», written without the space as in the text)

«قالَ: أَوْصى أَبُو الحَسَنِ مُوسى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ» reports an act of the Imam (a bequest) inside a narrated encounter: whether Musa b. Ja'far is a link is not settled by the rules; not added, flagged (rule 11)
«17 - نَصُّ آخَرُ» (a title) and the blessings are left out; the Ridha-bequest is the report's own matter, not a chain
